import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    p=params
    env=np.exp(-p[6]*t)
    f=env*(p[7]*np.cos(p[8]*t)+p[9]*np.sin(p[8]*t))*(1+p[5]*x)
    return p[0]+p[1]*x+p[2]*v+p[3]*x**2+p[4]*x**3+f
